name: HECBOT
summary: HECBOT, also known as Guanggu Dongzhi, is a Wuhan company founded in February 2025 that designs and produces robot bodies and develops applications for mixed robot fleets. Its Lumen robot family serves settings including elderly care, media and entertainment. The company identifies Agibot and the Peking University Wuhan Institute for Artificial Intelligence among its shareholders and operates humanoid robot production and testing facilities in Wuhan.
